objectives.text: Explain what IaC is
objectives.notes: Define Infrastructure as Code, contrast with manual provisioning

objectives.text: Describe advantages of IaC patterns
objectives.notes: Idempotency, consistency, repeatability, version control, auditability

objectives.text: Explain multi-cloud and provider-agnostic benefits
objectives.notes: Single workflow across AWS, Azure, GCP, and other providers

objectives.text: Explain the benefits of state
objectives.notes: State as the source of truth; resource tracking; performance

objectives.text: Install and version Terraform providers

objectives.notes: Provider blocks, aliases, required_providers

objectives.notes: Registry search order, mirror, filesystem_mirror, network_mirror

objectives.notes: Public registry, private registry, verified vs community modules/providers

domains.name: Use the Terraform CLI (outside of core workflow)

objectives.text: Given a scenario: choose when to use terraform fmt
